'''R7''' was an [[R-series]] [[astromech droid]] that served with [[Captain]] [[Carson Teva]] of the [[Adelphi Rangers]] on the planet [[Adelphi]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Chapter 10" /> The droid later served [[Colonel]] [[Ward]] in an [[X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOWeb|url=en-us/product/new-republic-x-wing-starfighter-75460|text=New Republic X-Wing Starfighter™}}</ref>

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
R7 first appeared in "[[Chapter 10: The Passenger]]," the tenth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Peyton Reed]].<ref name="Chapter 10" /> The [[droid]] wouldn't be identified until the twenty first episode, "[[Chapter 21: The Pirate]]," which was directed by [[Peter Ramsey]].<ref name="Chapter 21">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 21: The Pirate}}</ref> R7 was later featured in a [[LEGO]] set alongside Teva and [[Ward]]'s [[New Republic]] [[X-wing starfighter]] for the<ref name="LEGO75460">{{LEGOCite|num=75460|name=New Republic X-Wing Starfighter}}</ref> [[2026]]<ref name="TeaserTrailer">{{SWYouTube|_pa1KLXuW0Y|The Mandalorian and Grogu | Official Trailer | In Theaters May 22, 2026}}</ref> film ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu]]'' under the name "New Republic Astromech".<ref name="LEGO" />
